featured_reviews.name: bharti Butola
featured_reviews.review_text: We are deeply grateful that Nyra spent her foundation years at Rays Academy. The entire team has been warm, caring, and supportive, and Nyra truly loved going to school every day. As a parent, it has been such a relief knowing she was always in safe and loving hands. The school has played a beautiful role in her holistic development, helping her grow into a confident, happy, and curious child. As she now moves on from kindergarten, we pray she is blessed with the same nurturing teachers and Environment in her new school. Rays Academy will always hold a very special place in our hearts.

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Dange
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Rays Academy for my child was one of the best decisions we made as parents. The school provides a nurturing and friendly environment where children feel happy and secure.

We have noticed significant improvement in our child’s learning skills, creativity, and social behaviour. The teachers are dedicated, approachable, and always ready to guide both students and parents. Their teaching methods are engaging and make learning enjoyable for young kids.

The management and staff are well-organized and truly care about every child’s growth and development. We appreciate the regular updates and communication from the school.

Thank you to the entire team of Rays Academy for shaping a strong foundation for our child’s future. Highly recommended to all parents.

featured_reviews.name: Heena Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rays Academy has been the best choice for our child. The teachers give personal attention to each and every child, which makes a huge difference in their learning and confidence. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed and goes beyond regular textbooks, helping children learn in a more practical and engaging way.

They also include fieldwork and various extra activities that enhance children’s motor skills and overall development. Every event organized by the teachers is extremely well planned, with great care taken to ensure that all children are comfortable, safe, and enjoying themselves.

The school regularly organizes competitions and stage activities to build children’s confidence, encourage participation, and appreciate their efforts. This positive environment motivates students and helps them grow both academically and personally.

Overall, Rays Academy is the perfect place to build a strong foundation for a child and shape their future in the best possible way.

featured_reviews.review_text:
To be honest I am impressed by your curriculum and teaching methods which is different from other schools.  Well-planned worksheets for practice force my child to think beyond the prescribed textbook.

Rays Academy is excelling in all areas, especially giving immense exposure to the children.  Garv's communication and social skills have greatly increased due to the various classroom activities, good effort by all the teachers.  I am very thankful to all the teachers, coordinator and principal for groomed my child very well.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your thoughtful review! We’re delighted to have made a positive impact on your child's preschool journey.

featured_reviews.name: Ron Marc
featured_reviews.review_text: The Ray Academy Kindergarten has been amazing experience for me and my kids. The teacher's always give us the true feedback of our child as well as  have created an insight of the level of education to be expected from a 3 years old child. We appreciate your efforts. I like the teaching techniques which are fun and innovative. The whole experience was overwhelming and encouraging our kids to motivate them to perform better. Especially when you encourage them by giving them stars. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a nursery in the area and I feel very lucky to have found such a wonderful and happy environment for my childrens. A big thank you to all the team, we will never forget you!

customer_updates.name: Vivek Narayan Mishra
customer_updates.text:
मैं Sparkle Kids International School के संबंध में अपना अनुभव साझा करना चाहता हूँ।

स्कूल के एक स्टाफ सदस्य, श्री भोलेनाथ का अभिभावकों के प्रति व्यवहार अत्यंत रूखा और अस्वीकार्य रहा है। यह अनुभव न केवल मेरे लिए बल्कि अन्य अभिभावकों के लिए भी काफी निराशाजनक और आहत करने वाला है।

एक विद्यालय से अपेक्षा होती है कि वह बच्चों के साथ-साथ उनके अभिभावकों के प्रति भी सम्मानजनक, सहयोगात्मक और सकारात्मक वातावरण बनाए रखे। दुर्भाग्यवश, इस शाखा में ऐसा अनुभव नहीं हुआ।

मैं स्कूल प्रबंधन से निवेदन करता हूँ कि इस विषय को गंभीरता से लें और स्टाफ के व्यवहार एवं संचार में सुधार के लिए आवश्यक कदम उठाएं।

अपने इस अनुभव के आधार पर, मैं अभिभावकों को इस शाखा में अपने बच्चों का एडमिशन लेने से पहले सोच-विचार करने की सलाह दूंगाl

आशा है कि स्कूल इस प्रतिक्रिया को सकारात्मक रूप से लेकर सुधार की दिशा में कार्य करेगा। इस पोस्ट को अनाआवश्यक ना ले कर भोले नाथ को इस ब्रांच से हटाने के दिशा में निर्णय लेना चाहिए।
आज एक महिला के साथ कल दूसरी महिला के साथ होगा। इसकी जिम्मेदारी कौन लेगा?
